environment.description: Same Tomcat 9.0 servlet on ECS Fargate. Database connectivity routed through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction mode with a custom query parser module. PgBouncer configuration sets 'disable_dynamic_order_by = on' which rejects any query where the ORDER BY clause references identifiers not present in a pre-registered allowlist (loaded from /etc/pgbouncer/orderby_allowlist.conf containing: id, name, price, stock). Additionally, the PostgreSQL instance uses pg_query_guard extension (v2.4) configured with statement_inspection_mode = 'strict_dml' which aborts any SELECT containing subqueries or UNION in ORDER BY position. The RDS instance parameter group sets pg_query_guard.order_by_max_complexity = 1, preventing any expression more complex than a bare column reference in ORDER BY clauses.

config.network: ECS task -> PgBouncer sidecar -> RDS via private link
